resources.string: Fetch booked transactions straight from the bank instead of importing files. The app only reads, and only reaches the accounts you linked to your own Enable Banking application.
The key is stored encrypted on the phone and never goes into backups. Rows already imported from a file are not added again.
Create an application in the Enable Banking control panel (Production), link your own accounts there and register the same redirect address as here. Then pick the key file (.pem) you got.
Approve with BankID at %1$s in the browser. The app opens again when you are done.
Did you not come back to the app? Copy the address from the browser and paste it here.
The consent ended %1$s. Link the bank again.
%1$d new · %2$d already there from a file · %3$d to review
Fill in the application id and redirect address, and pick the key file.
The file is not an RSA key. Pick the .pem file from Enable Banking.
Enable Banking did not accept the key or the application id.
The redirect address is not one of the application\'s addresses at Enable Banking.
The application is not active yet. Link your accounts in the Enable Banking control panel first.
A consent has ended. Link the bank again to keep syncing.
The answer did not belong to this connection. Start again with Link bank.
The connection was stopped at the bank.
The bank is getting too many calls right now. Try again in a while.
The bank is not answering right now. Try again later.
No contact with Enable Banking. Check the network.
